scope: Existing CLI --document-steps JSON syntax diagnostic boundary only
scenario: A caller runs an original configuration with an external document-step file and captures stderr as a machine-readable diagnostic log. A malformed step file must not cause Node's native JSON SyntaxError excerpt to copy its contents into that log.

nonArray.error: Document steps must be an array

compatibility: Valid JSON step values and the complete document state/output schema remain unchanged.
Keep old 0/1/2 exits, UTF-8 and 400000-byte input handling; HOCON parse/resolve/getters and numeric/origin/budget semantics stay unchanged.
Do not sanitize or remove values from explicitly requested valid output; this is not general redaction of config errors, semantic messages, file paths, user-printed inputs or arbitrary logs.
acceptance: Record before-fix actual CLI streams plus numeric exit/status/signal receipts without modifying source.
Malformed JSON syntax must use the fixed value-free diagnostic in both ordinary and --json CLI modes.
Run actual input-file/include -> valid step processing -> full state output and recovery in the same caller; preserve all controls.
Capture the actual stderr byte log received by the caller, not an inferred manifest assertion.
One clean relevant verification, exact final-head real required CI plus this gate, full source/raw/test-copy/compiled/output byte freeze.
